# Security policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are applied to the latest revision of the default branch. This
project is evolving quickly and older snapshots are not maintained separately.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Do not open a public issue containing a vulnerability, credentials, personal
data, private URLs, logs, or exploit details.

Use the repository’s **Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability** flow.
If private vulnerability reporting is not available, contact the repository
owner privately through GitHub and share only enough information to arrange a
secure disclosure channel.

Include the affected revision, impact, reproduction conditions, and any safe
mitigation you have identified. Never test against a deployment you do not own
or have explicit permission to assess.

You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days. Fix and disclosure
timing depends on severity and whether an upstream provider is involved.
